Class GlobalExceptionHandler

java.lang.Object
app.auth.GlobalExceptionHandler
@RestControllerAdvice public class GlobalExceptionHandler extends Object
Translates controller exceptions and validation errors into HTTP error responses with an {"error": "..."} body. Missing or invalid tokens are rejected earlier, by SecurityErrorHandler.
